summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no changes made) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `server.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite.  Everything I could verify statically looks correctly wired: - Client always fetches live from `/watchlist` on mount (`api.get`), no `localStorage`/anonymous fallback anywhere in the watchlist code. - `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"`, and CORS on the server has `credentials: true`, so the session cookie should travel with e
